queries.focal_ptsd: "posttraumatic stress disorder" OR "post-traumatic stress disorder" OR "PTSD" OR "complex PTSD" OR "complex posttraumatic stress disorder"
queries.focal_trauma: "trauma" OR "traumatic stress" OR "psychological trauma" OR "vicarious trauma" OR "secondary traumatic stress" OR "collective trauma" OR "intergenerational trauma" OR "trauma-informed" OR "trauma informed" OR "moral injury"
queries.ancestors: "shell shock" OR "war neurosis" OR "combat neurosis" OR "traumatic neurosis" OR "battle fatigue" OR "combat fatigue" OR "gross stress reaction" OR "post-Vietnam syndrome" OR "rape trauma syndrome"
queries.family: TI ("posttraumatic stress disorder" OR "post-traumatic stress disorder" OR "PTSD" OR "complex PTSD" OR "trauma" OR "traumatic stress" OR "psychological trauma" OR "vicarious trauma" OR "secondary traumatic stress" OR "collective trauma" OR "intergenerational trauma" OR "trauma-informed" OR "trauma informed" OR "moral injury" OR "shell shock" OR "war neurosis" OR "combat neurosis" OR "traumatic neurosis" OR "battle fatigue" OR "combat fatigue" OR "gross stress reaction" OR "post-Vietnam syndrome" OR "rape trauma syndrome" OR "acute stress disorder" OR "adjustment disorder" OR "bereavement") OR AB (<same 26 terms>)
queries.family_health: (TI (<25 terms, no bare "trauma">) OR AB (<25 terms, no bare "trauma">)) OR (TI ("trauma") AND (TI (psycholog* OR "mental health" OR emotional OR stress OR "nurses" OR "nursing") OR AB (psycholog* OR "mental health" OR emotional OR stress OR "nurses" OR "nursing")))

exclusions.why: NOT excluded on purpose — the somatic sense is the origin of the creep story; expect a physical-injury clade in CINAHL/medicine and read it as a jingle finding, not noise. Revisit if it swamps the health source (>60% of kept docs).

exclusions.term: bare 'trauma' in CINAHL, abstract-only or without psychological vocabulary
exclusions.why: DECIDED 2026-09-08: bare 'trauma' TI/AB in CINAHL = 97,028, overwhelmingly the injury sense (trauma center, trauma patients). Health samples bare 'trauma' by title only where psycholog*/mental health/emotional/stress/nurs* co-occur (38,795). The physical sense still enters via the specific phrases and is read as a labeled probe. Psyc keeps the FULL union (110,040) because abstract-only mentions of bare 'trauma' are the extraordinary->ordinary signal.

DECIDED 2026-09-08: not sampled. The somatic->psychic creep predates the 1975 window; a general MEDLINE pull would flood the 'trauma' shards with the injury homonym (17's per-period cap samples from the pooled corpus). CINAHL carries the health habitat and keeps the homonym visible as a labeled probe. Revisit as a MeSH-scoped, labeled source only if a medicine-backflow question is asked.

exclusions.habitat: Historical Abstracts / humanities (memory studies, literary trauma theory)
exclusions.why: collective-trauma lineage (Caruth 1996; Alexander 2004) — leads to verify; not in the 13-DB budget; decide

ignore.why: PARTIAL deliveries from the EBSCO email export, kept for the record, never ingested. 09-08: 1965-94 1,800/6,192; 2015-19 10,802/22,985; 2020-22 2,489/18,367. 09-09 re-request of 2015-19: 2,452 (83% overlapping the first fragment -> truncated heads of the relevance-ranked list, NOT random samples; biased toward high-mention records; first fragment also had ~13% within-file duplicates). 09-09 PM batch: Psyc 2023 842/6,742 and Health 2020-25 8,812/16,660 partial. Mitigation: single-year slices, requests spaced a few minutes apart, every delivery checked against expected n before renaming.
